rachel.zhao: Auditor asked for a reproducible extraction playbook and two sample bundles (RBAC + KMS). Need exact commands, S3 paths, signing steps, retention, and mapping to SOC2/ISO controls. Can owners confirm they can produce samples by EOD?

sec-ops-bot: Reminder: attach manifests and GPG-signed checksums. I'll create task AUD-2026-511 when samples are uploaded.

nidhi.singh: I'll take RBAC sample. Minimal export commands (AWS + k8s):

# terraform plan export
terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > /tmp/tfplan.json

# CloudTrail slice for IAM events (example timestamps)
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" \
  --filter-pattern "CreateUser|DeleteUser|AttachRolePolicy|PutRolePolicy|UpdateAssumeRolePolicy" \
  --start-time 1688000000000 --end-time 1688000360000 > /tmp/iam_events.json

# k8s bindings and serviceaccounts
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces > /tmp/rolebindings.yaml
kubectl get sa --all-namespaces -o yaml > /tmp/serviceaccounts.yaml

# produce manifest and sign
sha256sum /tmp/tfplan.json /tmp/iam_events.json /tmp/rolebindings.yaml /tmp/serviceaccounts.yaml > /tmp/manifest.txt
gpg --local-user nidhi@redwood --armor --detach-sign /tmp/manifest.txt

nidhi.singh: Upload layout: s3://audit-exports/rbac/{ticket}/{ts}/tfplan.json, iam_events.json, rolebindings.yaml, serviceaccounts.yaml, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc
Maps to: SOC2 CC6.1 (change management evidence), ISO A.9.2.3 (user access provisioning audit trail).

tom_brooks: I'll produce the KMS sample. Commands (AWS KMS example):

# key metadata and policy
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-cmk > /tmp/key_meta.json
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-cmk --policy-name default > /tmp/key_policy.json

# CloudTrail events for rotation and grants
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" \
  --filter-pattern "CreateKey|RotateKey|DisableKey|CreateGrant|RevokeGrant" \
  --start-time 1688000000000 --end-time 1688000360000 > /tmp/kms_events.json

# envelope evidence: list encrypted backup objects
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-encrypted-backups --prefix enc- --output json > /tmp/encrypted_backups.json

# manifest + sign
sha256sum /tmp/key_meta.json /tmp/key_policy.json /tmp/kms_events.json /tmp/encrypted_backups.json > /tmp/manifest.txt
gpg --local-user tom@redwood --armor --detach-sign /tmp/manifest.txt

 tom_brooks: Upload path: s3://audit-exports/kms/prod-cmk/{ts}/key_meta.json, key_policy.json, kms_events.json, encrypted_backups.json, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc
Maps to: SOC2 CC6.2 (cryptographic key lifecycle), ISO A.10.1 (cryptographic controls). We will also encrypt the bundle with the CMK and include key_arn in manifest.

rachel.zhao: Retention + immutability notes: hot S3 (365 days), archived to Glacier Deep (7 years). Finalized bundles will have S3 Object Lock GOVERNANCE applied and object metadata includes uploader, job_id, manifest_sha256, and object-lock ID. Raw slack transcripts or PII must be redacted before inclusion; raw copies restricted to SecOps JIT access.

sec-ops-bot: Created task AUD-2026-511 (verification window 2026-04-09T14:00Z). Please attach sample bundles and a README with verification steps so the auditor can run sha256sum and gpg --verify on the manifest.

rachel.zhao: Thanks — ping me in the ticket when uploads are complete.
